Subject: It's been a minute — we noticed
Preview: No pitch. Just checking in.
Body: Hey,

You picked up some gear from us recently. We hope it's already been put to use — or at least packed and ready.

We know you don't need us to tell you what to bring on a trip. But if something's on your list and you've been sitting on it, we're here when you're ready.

No discount code, no countdown timer. Just a straightforward invite to come back and look around when the timing makes sense for you.

See what's in stock.
